He does tend to be very mischievous at times, but it is easily controlled by us. We are very worried about these strange dreams. Please interpret this dreams for us. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 21557 Country: United States of America Title: 1. I had heard that a dream right before Fajr is supposed to be a true dream. Is it true? 2. Right before I awoke for Fajr, I saw a dream I was standing next to a lake; I began to throw stones, and they began skipping in the water, farther than I ever did before. What does this mean? Question: 1. I had heard that a dream right before Fajr is supposed to be a true dream. Is it true? 2. Right before I awoke for Fajr, I saw a dream I was standing next to a lake; I began to throw stones, and they began skipping in the water, farther than I ever did before. What does this mean? Answer ID: 21557 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 721/584/B=1431) (1) This is not the final rule; however the dream before Fajr salah usually comes to be true. (2) You seem to be too much involved in worldly affairs; you should get yourself busy in good deeds and take care of injunctions and prohibitions of Islamic teaching. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
